components.name: Editable settings controls
components.description: Official shadcn/Radix Select and Checkbox, shown here as self-contained visual states. Settings trigger: 39px high; 16px chevron, measured 13px right inset and 0px vertical-center offset. Key-removal checkbox: 14px square, 9px label gap, navy checked state; distinct from 36×21px native switches. Full forms include the separate recipient Badge/combobox editor, sender, blank key with keep-current guidance, advanced limits, dirty/saving/saved feedback, and an independent current/new/confirm password form with separate busy/error/success states. Static menu preview demonstrates focused and selected items; production keyboard and popup behavior belong to Radix. Notification copy refers to new NMC announcements: baseline imports send no email and existing-entry changes stay in history. Recipient changes apply to newly detected notices; queued emails retain their original recipients and retry payloads.

components.name: Recipient editor
components.description: Official shadcn Badge chips in a wrapping combobox field, with initials and individually labeled remove buttons. Count is selected/20; long addresses wrap. Suggestions use only the actual signed-in account and saved addresses, excluding selected entries. Production supports keyboard suggestion navigation, Enter/comma/semicolon/Tab commit, bulk paste, case normalization, deduplication, validation, an inline alert, and polite live announcements. Blur closes suggestions without committing or moving the Save action; Save includes pending typed email. This self-contained visual preview shows the chip and suggestion states without implementing the React interaction.

narrative.overview:
An operating desk for public notices: calm, compact, and explicit about the monitor’s actual state. Navy carries brand, navigation, and the main action; white and pale blue separate the working surfaces. Restrained green marks source continuity and healthy outcomes.

The user-pinned navy-and-white theme and shadcnblocks sidebar foundation define the visual world. System sans-serif typography handles operational content; Georgia lends the source identity and sign-in heading a modest institutional character. Notivo owns the identity: NMC is identified as the source, without institute or official NMC logos.
keyCharacteristics: Compact operational hierarchy with readable notice titles.
Flat white panels on a pale blue workspace.
Navy actions, restrained semantic status color, and thin dividers.
A persistent desktop sidebar that becomes a mobile sheet.

rules.name: The State Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Semantic colors explain actual state; they are not a second brand palette.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Separate ordinary content with tone, spacing, and borders; reserve pronounced elevation for overlays.

dos: Do preserve the navy-and-white theme and shadcnblocks sidebar foundation.
Do show semantic status with a text label as well as color.
Do allow long notice titles, errors, and addresses to wrap.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
Do keep Select chevrons vertically centered at the right and checkbox labels separated by the established (9px) gap.
Do keep routine email/password sign-in distinct from one-time admin setup, and show form feedback next to the action it describes.
Do identify Notivo as the private workspace and NMC as the document source.
donts: Don’t use the SNMIH logo or official NMC logos, or imply official NMC affiliation.
Don’t turn status color into decorative page-wide emphasis.
Don’t replace the flat panel hierarchy with pervasive shadows.
Don’t truncate notice titles merely to equalize row height.
